_readme: S698 (SkyAuklet), 2026-11-21, under Sam's go in session on #3655 ("good, let's do it!"): the subject heading the catalog prints above each subject's first course, for the local subject titles on the Commons' Subjects page. The same source and the same course-heading pattern as los_angeles_valley_courses.json (the filed catalog, kb/hand_filed_catalogs/courses/los_angeles_valley.json.gz), which kept each course from its heading line down and so kept no subject heading. This read prints only the lines above each subject's first course. No model call.
